title: Settings group
summary: One screen per settings group (privacy, account, chats, help, and the profile group from the Você header). The screen renders the sections and rows of that group from registries/settings.json, so iOS and Android show the same rows in the same order.

key.description: The row key in the registry.

kind.description: The row kind of the registry.

footer.description: A bipe_* string key under the row.

value.description: The current value shown on choice, switch and info rows.

visible.description: The row's gate passes on this platform (absent, the platform name, a flag that is on). planned:<issue> hides the row; an unknown gate hides it (fail closed).

rows.description: Section by section, in registry order. A section with no visible row is hidden.

tapRow.effect: link: opens the row's screen (see notes). choice: opens the picker. switch: flips and saves. url: opens the urls entry for the app language in the system browser. action and destructive: run the row (see notes). info: nothing.

notes: Every title and footer comes from the generated settings code (BipeSettings), never hard-coded. The strings list above names the rows of this issue; rows of other areas (privacy rows, profile rows, chats rows) are specified with their screens (bipe-chat/bipe#567, #561, #563).

Row targets in this issue: account.changePin → pin-change; account.appLock and account.biometricUnlock → app-lock; account.recoveryKey → recovery-key-save; account.linkedDevices → linked-devices; account.signOut → sign-out; account.email → the recovery e-mail rows (set, change, remove with PUT and DELETE /v1/me/email; Bipe logic BipeAPIClient.setRecoveryEmail and removeRecoveryEmail, Android account/ui/BipeRecoveryEmailRows); account.add → signup-name in the second-account flow (ADR 0086, ADR 0135); privacy.export → data-export; help.support → support-chat; help.reportProblem → problem-report; help.docs, help.terms, help.privacy → url rows; help.licenses → help-about.
account.pin footer: bipe_account_pin_footer (takes pinLength) with one account on the phone; bipe_account_pin_footer_device with two or more (ADR 0086: the lock uses one device PIN).
Gate rules: Bipe logic BipeSettingsRow and BipeSettingsSection extensions (iOS BipeSettingsSupport.swift), BipeSettingsGate (Android). The url language is pt-BR unless the phone is in English.
There is no Remover senha row (ADR 0057). Apagar conta, Proteção contra roubo and Minha empresa wait for their own decisions (ADR 0112 consequences).
